description: Fetches a public GitHub repo's README (raw.githubusercontent.com, up to 300 KB) and scans its install instructions before you clone it or follow them. Use it when a user or agent is told to 'clone this repo and run the setup' or is evaluating a starter kit, trading bot, wallet tool or MCP server from GitHub. Free and read-only: one unauthenticated HTTPS request to GitHub; nothing is cloned or executed. Only the README is checked here. The optional paid hosted check (https://repo-run-check.nextill-pos.workers.dev/v1/check, 0.005 USDC via x402 on Base) also reads package.json install scripts, dependencies, setup files and repo metadata such as age and fake-star signals. This tool does not pay for it; it only returns its URL. Returns verdict: no_red_flags (nothing matched; not proof of safety), review_before_running (at least one warning: read the flagged lines first) or dangerous (download-and-execute, encoded payloads, known malware hosts and similar: do not run), plus repo, url, advice, files_checked, findings, install_commands, tier, full_report (URL of the paid check) and full_report_price_usdc. Errors if the repo is private, renamed or missing. If the repo is already cloned, check_local_repo covers more files at no cost.

repo.description: Public GitHub repository as owner/repo or https://github.com/owner/repo (a trailing .git or path is fine). Other hosts are not supported.

name: check_repo
title: Check a public GitHub repo's install steps
